about: LV 3.3 V on JP1, HV 5 V on JP2, every line released: each side pulled up to its own rail, the MOSFETs off. Values with 'note' are assumptions.

lv1_low.about: a device on the low side pulls LV1 low (2 mA sink): HV1 follows through Q1's channel
lv1_low.note: 2 mA: an open-drain output (assumed); 0.8 V: a TTL low, the test's expectation

hv1_low.about: a device on the high side pulls HV1 low (2 mA sink): LV1 follows, first through Q1's body diode, then its channel
